name: pretypist
description: A prose-first typing trainer for split, layered keyboards.

scripts.audit:release: node scripts/audit-release.mjs && node scripts/build-pwa.mjs --check && node scripts/package-layout.mjs --check && node scripts/adapt-authored-model.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-zmk-display-assets.mjs --check && clojure -M:corpus --check && node scripts/audit-landing.mjs
scripts.author:model:legacy: node scripts/generate-model.mjs --output target/blender/model-reference.glb && node scripts/blender-mcp-client.mjs scripts/blender/build_modified_engram.py && node scripts/stamp-blender-model.mjs
scripts.prepare:assets: npm run analyze:corpora && npm run sync:corpora && npm run generate:model && npm run generate:zmk-display-assets && npm run package:layout
scripts.test: npm run prepare:assets && npm run check:corpora && npm run test:model-audit && npm run test:model-electronics && npm run test:zmk-display && npm run test:zmk-display-assets && clojure -M:test -m cljs.main -co test.cljs.edn -c pretypist.test-runner && node target/test.js
scripts.build: npm run prepare:assets && clojure -M -m cljs.main -co release.cljs.edn -c pretypist.core && npm run build:pwa && npm run audit:release
